hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central America, bordering the Caribbean Sea, between Guatemala and Nicaragua and bordering the Gulf of Fonseca (North Pacific Ocean), between El Salvador and Nicaragua || mostly mountains in interior, narrow coastal plains || has only a short Pacific coast but a long Caribbean shoreline, including the virtually uninhabited eastern Mosquito Coast || Resources: timber, gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, iron ore, antimony, coal, fish, hydropower || Exports: garments, coffee, insulated wire, palm oil, shellfish (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountains in interior, narrow coastal plains || Central America, bordering the Caribbean Sea, between Guatemala and Nicaragua and bordering the Gulf of Fonseca (North Pacific Ocean), between El Salvador and Nicaragua

climate.excerpt: subtropical in lowlands, temperate in mountains || frequent, but generally mild, earthquakes; extremely susceptible to damaging hurricanes and floods along the Caribbean coast

economy.excerpt: second-fastest-growing Central American economy; COVID-19 and two hurricanes crippled activity; high poverty and inequality; declining-but-still-high violent crime disruption; systemic corruption; coffee and banana exporter; enormous remittances || Exports: garments, coffee, insulated wire, palm oil, shellfish (2023) || Industries: sugar processing, coffee, woven and knit apparel, wood products, cigars
